Machine Learning Engineer
Location: Bengaluru, India
Experience: 3+ years

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production ML systems.

About Us:
We are a premier AI engineering platform empowering developers and enterprises with intelligent workflows.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and deploy machine learning models using Python and PyTorch.
- Build scalable APIs and backend microservices with FastAPI and Docker.
- Manage distributed training and inference workloads on AWS and Kubernetes.
- Implement ML experiment tracking and model registry using MLflow.
- Collaborate with data engineering to optimize SQL pipelines and data workflows.

Skill-Specific Experience:
- Python: 3+ years
- Machine Learning: 2+ years
- FastAPI: 1+ year
- SQL: 2+ years

Required Skills:
- Python, SQL, FastAPI, Docker
- Machine Learning, scikit-learn, PyTorch

Preferred Skills:
- AWS, Kubernetes, MLflow
